# Chapter 3: The Argument

The committee met on a self-governing Tuesday, not because the charter required it, but because the promise-making season had arrived early. Mara argued that a well-formed hyphenated compound like twenty-first-century habits should never be mistaken for a broken PDF line.

She cited Smith (2020) and noted that ISBN metadata belongs in front matter, not in the middle of a courtroom speech. The vote was close, but the prose remained intact.
